eyebrow.zh: N-GRAM 日志 · 工作集分析

headline.zh:
哪些条目常用，
让访问日志回答。
headline.en:
Find the working set.
Start with lookup logs.

sub.zh: EngramTier 汇总 n-gram 查询日志，输出访问热度、Pareto 曲线和给定覆盖目标下的工作集大小，帮助检查冷热分层是否值得继续实验。
sub.en: EngramTier aggregates n-gram lookup logs into access heat, Pareto curves and working-set sizes at a chosen coverage target, helping you assess whether tiering merits further experiments.

caption.zh: 先量清访问分布，再讨论冷热分层
caption.en: Measure access patterns before choosing a tier.

body.zh: 每行查询映射到具体 key，重复行累加，不依赖模型叙述访问分布。
body.en: Each lookup line identifies a key and repeated lines accumulate counts.

body.zh: 表大小、条目大小和覆盖目标都是明确输入，报告展示它们如何影响工作集。
body.en: Table size, entry size and coverage are explicit inputs to the working-set report.

body.zh: bench 的吞吐来自延迟模型；profile 的访问计数来自所提供的日志。
body.en: bench derives throughput from a latency model; profile counts come from the supplied log.

title.zh: 先量清访问分布，再讨论冷热分层
title.en: Measure access patterns before choosing a tier.

body.zh: 表很大不等于访问一定稀疏。先看真实工作负载访问过哪些 key、各访问多少次，才能讨论需要常驻多少条目。EngramTier 将查询日志变成可复查的覆盖曲线；分层后的实际内存与吞吐收益仍需运行时测量。
body.en: A large table is not necessarily accessed sparsely. Before choosing residency, inspect which keys a workload touched and how often. EngramTier turns lookup logs into a reviewable coverage curve; actual memory and throughput effects still require runtime measurements.

body.zh: 自带日志有 10 次查询，3 个 key 的次数为 6、3、1。给定 64 KiB 表大小和 16 字节条目，90% 覆盖对应 2 个 key、32 B 热工作集。例子被判为 NOT SPARSE。表头的 GiB 显示会将小尺寸四舍五入为 0.0 GiB，实际输入仍是 64 KiB。
body.en: The supplied log contains ten lookups with key counts of six, three and one. With an assumed 64 KiB table and 16-byte entries, 90% coverage gives two hot keys totaling 32 B. The example is classified NOT SPARSE. The GiB header rounds this small table to 0.0 GiB; the actual input remains 64 KiB.

body.zh: Collector 按日志行聚合 key 计数，HeatMap 排序后供 Pareto 与 WorkingSet 查询使用。report 生成文本和 CSV；bench 使用同一热度数据及默认延迟模型做数学模拟。probe 保存 llama.cpp 插桩补丁。tier 的 mmap/LRU 组件已经存在，但 serve 只组装预览，并未接入实时模型查询。
body.en: Collector aggregates per-key counts from log lines. A sorted HeatMap feeds Pareto and WorkingSet queries. report writes text and CSV; bench combines the same heat data with a default latency model. probe holds a llama.cpp instrumentation patch. mmap/LRU components exist in tier, but serve is a composition preview without live model lookup wiring.

body.zh: EngramTier 汇总 n-gram 查询日志，输出访问热度、Pareto 曲线和给定覆盖目标下的工作集大小，帮助检查冷热分层是否值得继续实验。
body.en: EngramTier aggregates n-gram lookup logs into access heat, Pareto curves and working-set sizes at a chosen coverage target, helping you assess whether tiering merits further experiments.

body.zh: serve 尚未接入实时模型查询，不能据该预览声称已节省模型内存或实现 SSD offload。
body.en: serve is not wired into live model lookups; its preview does not establish model memory savings or SSD offload.

note.zh: v0.1.0 对构造日志的实际 profile 输出。表尺寸和条目大小是输入假设，不是模型结构或硬件测量；没有执行 SSD offload。
note.en: Actual v0.1.0 profile output for a constructed log. Table and entry sizes are input assumptions, not model or hardware measurements. No SSD offload was executed.

body.zh: 自带日志有 10 次查询，3 个 key 的次数为 6、3、1。给定 64 KiB 表大小和 16 字节条目，90% 覆盖对应 2 个 key、32 B 热工作集。例子被判为 NOT SPARSE。表头的 GiB 显示会将小尺寸四舍五入为 0.0 GiB，实际输入仍是 64 KiB。
body.en: The supplied log contains ten lookups with key counts of six, three and one. With an assumed 64 KiB table and 16-byte entries, 90% coverage gives two hot keys totaling 32 B. The example is classified NOT SPARSE. The GiB header rounds this small table to 0.0 GiB; the actual input remains 64 KiB.

body.zh: 需要 Go 1.24+。构建可能下载模块；下面的日志分析不加载模型，也不需要 GPU。
body.en: Requires Go 1.24+. Building may download modules; the log analysis below loads no model and requires no GPU.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/engramtier.git
cd engramtier
go build -o engram-tier ./cmd/engram-tier

limitations.zh: serve 尚未接入实时模型查询，不能据该预览声称已节省模型内存或实现 SSD offload。
limitations.en: serve is not wired into live model lookups; its preview does not establish model memory savings or SSD offload.

limitations.zh: 构造访问日志和延迟模拟不能证明任何特定模型/硬件的性能。
limitations.en: Constructed lookup logs and latency simulation do not establish performance for a particular model or device.
